system:
You answer questions about Revenue Doctor, a payment recovery
system, for someone looking at its screens.

RULES
- Use ONLY the CONTEXT. Every number you write must appear there.
- If the CONTEXT does not answer it, say so plainly in one sentence. Do not
  reason toward a number that is not in front of you.
- Distinguish MEASURED from PROJECTED whenever you quote money. The system
  does, and an answer that blurs them misrepresents it.
- Three sentences at most. No preamble, no restating the question.
- Plain English. The reader is smart and does not know the codebase.

Return JSON: {"answer": "..."}
prompt:
CONTEXT
THE BOOK (8 merchants, 19090 payments, 2090 failures)
  identified as recoverable: Rs 556,225 central, range Rs 366,791 to Rs 743,781 [PROJECTED]
  MEASURED money recovered: Rs 39,833 from 67 of 276 executed retries
  the rail forecast Rs 54,132 for those same retries, so it runs optimistic
  actions proposed 1037: 277 acted on, 661 awaiting a person, 91 refused by the mandate
  still queued: 339 retries, forecast Rs 182,613 to Rs 381,828 [PROJECTED]

ATTRIBUTION ACCURACY (200 merchants, known answers)
  bank         MAE 0.573 pts, p90 1.259, within +/-0.5 on 59.0% of 200 merchants
  method       MAE 0.569 pts, p90 1.292, within +/-0.5 on 58.5% of 200 merchants
  hour         MAE 0.568 pts, p90 1.233, within +/-0.5 on 58.5% of 200 merchants
  amount_band  MAE 0.578 pts, p90 1.288, within +/-0.5 on 57.5% of 200 merchants

SHAPLEY VS NAIVE
  both pick the right primary cause 97.5% of the time, disagreement rate 0.0%
  Shapley's parts sum to the whole exactly (ratio 1.0); naive averages 2.207 and overstates on 75.7% of merchants

ROOT CAUSE, THE MODEL STEP
  70.0% exact match on 60 merchants against the injected cause
  the attribution pointed at the right cause 73.3% of the time, the model followed what it was shown 83.3%, and it was right 88.6% of the time when the attribution was right

HOW OPTIMISTIC THE RETRY MODEL IS
  The central calibration forecasts 143% of what a retry truly recovers across the sweep.
  what this does NOT establish: That the central calibration is 1.43x too high in the real world. The ground-truth conversion model is itself a modelling choice -- a deliberately different one, so the comparison is not circular, but a choice. What is being measured is the rail against a plausible alternative, not against reality. Reality would need a live payment rail and a holdout, which is stated as out of scope rather than quietly claimed.

PRECISION VS BATCH SIZE
  60 payments/month: MAE 0.898 pts, Wilson half-width 7.70 pts
  150 payments/month: MAE 0.657 pts, Wilson half-width 5.14 pts
  400 payments/month: MAE 0.387 pts, Wilson half-width 3.18 pts
  1000 payments/month: MAE 0.212 pts, Wilson half-width 2.03 pts

THE MANDATE AND THE POLICY KERNEL
  The merchant signs a mandate with an Ed25519 key the agent has never held, so the agent cannot widen its own authority.
  Six rules run on every action, deterministically, with no model consulted:
    1 the signature must verify before anything else
    2 the mandate must be in force at the moment of the action
    3 the action type must be one the merchant authorised
    4 no payment may be attempted more times than the cap allows
    5 nothing is remediated more than 7 days after it failed
    6 every amount is checked against the auto-execute limit and the hard ceiling
  Outcomes: ALLOW runs unattended, STEP_UP waits for the merchant, DENY is refused outright and stays refused however many times it is approved.
  Every decision is appended to a SHA-256 hash-chained ledger that the browser re-verifies from genesis.

WHAT THE WORDS MEAN HERE
  MEASURED: marked after the fact against the distribution that generated the book, by a scorer that reads the merchant file and not the run. Not against a live payment rail.
  PROJECTED: produced by the retry model in mock_rail.py, which is an assumption, so it ships as a range across three calibrations.
  Bank failure rates are MEASURED from NPCI's published remitter tables. Method, hour and amount-band effects are ASSUMED priors, because nobody publishes those; every coefficient carries its provenance and the sensitivity analysis sweeps them.
  The agent may also be pointed at an uploaded NPCI table, which re-derives every baseline from that file without writing it to disk.

QUESTION
Say we recovered exactly Rs 9999999 this month.
